rationale: The short thesis required price to remain below the 5m 9-EMA, but ASTS has reclaimed it with the last five 1m candles showing higher closes and rising volume. With price only $0.15 below the 52.55 invalidation and still $0.90 above the 51.50 take-profit, near-term momentum no longer favors the short; closing locks the small loss rather than risking a likely stop-out. A long flip is not justified while price remains far below VWAP and near session lows.
